sources.quote: A temporary deviation may cover at most 2000 pieces and at most 6 weeks.
The allowed responses to a late approved source are: expedite the approved source, or request a temporary deviation within the limits of section 2.

findings.why: The proposal asks for 3,500 BR-220 pieces over 10 weeks. That is above both limits in the procedure in force, which are 2000 pieces and 6 weeks. The 100% hole inspection meets the fastener-hole requirement, but it does not change the quantity or duration limits.

sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis requirements in force. A temporary deviation therefore needs written Stellantis approval through the portal before any shipment. No approval is in the documents. The only recorded deviation, DEV-2025-019, is for a different part and customer (HS-040, CLM).
